# Chase Construction LLC

> Custom log home builders, big timber framing, and log home restoration serving Sun Valley, Ketchum, Hailey, and Bellevue, Idaho. Three decades of craftsmanship building and restoring luxury log homes engineered to last generations in the Idaho mountains.

Chase Construction LLC is a general contractor based in Bellevue, Idaho, specializing in high-end log and timber construction across the Wood River Valley and the wider Sun Valley corridor. The company builds custom log homes from design through completion, executes big-timber structural framing, and restores weathered or failing log homes — including re-chinking, re-staining, and structural log repair. Contact: 208-897-8100 · https://www.chaseconstruction.org

## Services

- [Custom Log Homes](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/custom-log-homes.html): Full-service custom log home construction in Sun Valley, Ketchum, and Hailey, Idaho — from design to completion, managing every detail.
- [Big Timber Framing](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/big-timber-framing.html): Structural timber framing for luxury homes — big-timber expertise that defines the scale and character of exceptional homes.
- [Log Home Restorations](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/log-home-restorations.html): Log home restoration and maintenance — structural repair through full restoration.
- [Log Home Chinking & Staining](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/log-home-chinking-staining.html): Re-chinking failing joints and re-staining weathered logs to seal a log home against Idaho weather.
- [Custom Log Finishes & Siding](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/custom-log-finishes-siding.html): Log siding, chinking, staining, and custom finish work that protects and defines the exterior of luxury log homes.
- [Traditional Framing](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/traditional-framing.html): Precision residential framing for complex, high-end builds near Boise and the Sun Valley corridor.
- [Milling & More](https://www.chaseconstruction.org/milling-and-more.html): On-site bandsaw and circular milling, lumber cut to specification, cabinetry, and specialty builds.
